reason: The prior REAL_SUPERWORKER promotions composed evidence from materially different execution systems. V6 broad cognition was produced by a ChatGPT controller session, while persistence/relaunch/task acquisition/dedupe evidence came from deterministic controllers and other runtimes. Joining those booleans did not prove that one integrated cognitive worker possessed the entire loop.
preserved_truth: V6 demonstrated broad cross-domain research/code/artifact work in a ChatGPT controller session.
Deterministic controllers demonstrated durable state, checkpoint/relaunch, dedupe, provider failover, and task machinery.
Clean-room reproduction demonstrated reproducibility of the deterministic controller mechanism.
Two-worker scaling measurement remains valid only for the deterministic controller mechanism.
revoked_claims: SUPERWORKER-INTEGRATED-1 counts as one real integrated cognitive Superworker
SUPERWORKER-INTEGRATED-2 counts as a second real integrated cognitive Superworker
required_next_step: Build one single integrated cognitive worker in which the same durable identity executes goal->reason->discover->research->act->inspect->correct->verify->checkpoint->resume->finish, then prove that exact system end-to-end without stitching capability evidence across different executors.
